messages.content:
Task: Locate the anchor function for the exposure_digest field in the console.log object whose action is flag.exposure after typing the exposure user, choosing the flag, enabling send-exposure, and clicking Record Exposure on the page. The same exposure_digest value is also sent inside the body of a fetch POST request to the exposure endpoint issued on record. The anchor function is the first target-specific request-transform value constructor on the dynamic behavior chain: after delegated click routing, action routing, the exposure gate, exposure material collection with page-context snapshot, tuple input preparation, asynchronous scheduling and runtime config selection, its function body itself constructs the target observable exposure digest rather than merely collecting inputs, dispatching control, wrapping a return value, or writing the value to the console or fetch call. Return exactly one complete function as a single JSON object (see answer_format). Do not return generic utilities, event handlers, the full call chain, the final console sink, or the fetch call site. Note: you may only inspect code under captures; the full codebase is not accessible.

Example value: ex_00004wrnhnhm0c5z
Observable: {'type': 'console', 'action': 'flag.exposure', 'field': 'exposure_digest'}
Candidate seed nodes (lexical prior, not a ranking): ['1ef1137073e0fc19', 'cc28ce16a11b6c36', 'b8054853fb0b045c', '2e06b3527996fe19', '808c65e08f6b2b33', 'f54131fbfd23dcd1', 'd6dab628e86bc51a', '0b12c70c6c7dea47']
Use search_entity / traverse_graph / retrieve_entity, then call submit with file, start_offset, and end_offset for ONE complete function.

tools.description: List neighbours of a function node along an edge type. edge in {invokes, invoked_by, parent, child, event}.
